dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: We can discuss further, if you'd like. We offer packages tailored for different needs — and you're free to take your pick of the lot.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: Just provide your name, address, guarantor... and your detailed travel log for the past three months. The more detailed, the better.

dialogues.speaker: Jarosznski
dialogues.text: Don't think too much about it. All this is so we can offer you a more professional payment plan.
